note: underlying of the confidential token is wsFUND (plain SEP-41, NOT a SAC); sac_passthrough=false so the allowlist-policy is the sole on-chain eligibility gate. The auditor key (auditor_id 0) is K_aud = 1*H = H (sk_aud=1) — EXAMPLE ONLY, publicly decryptable. It was rotated from the Grumpkin value-generator G to H because an auditor ECDH channel is only decryptable when K_aud = sk_aud*H; G is not of that form (unknown DLOG base H), so a G key could never decrypt transfer ciphertexts. With K_aud=H the auditor genuinely recovers the transferred amount from both the sender and recipient channels (scripts/auditor_decrypt.sh).
